translations.idiomatic: As soon as he took office, he submitted a memorial saying, "Broaden the path of speech and then one knows gain and loss; reach the people's sentiments and then one knows benefit and harm.

sentences.zh: 竊見去歲五月，詔求讜言，士民爭欲自獻。

translations.literal: I privately observe that last year in the fifth month an edict sought forthright words; scholars and commoners competed to offer themselves.
translations.idiomatic: I privately observe that last year in the fifth month an edict sought forthright words, and scholars and commoners competed to offer themselves.

sentences.zh: 及詳觀詔語，名雖求諫，實欲拒言，約束丁寧，使不得觀望迎合，犯令干譽，終之以必行黜罰以恐懼之。

translations.literal: But on closely examining the edict's language, though nominally seeking remonstrance, it actually wished to reject speech; constraints were repeated and earnest, preventing observation and compliance, violating orders and seeking reputation, ending with certain dismissal and punishment to terrify them.
translations.idiomatic: But on closely examining the edict's language, though nominally seeking remonstrance, it actually wished to reject speech. Constraints were repeated and earnest, preventing hedging and flattery, warning against violating orders and seeking reputation, and ending with certain dismissal and punishment to terrify them.

sentences.zh: 於是人人知戒，言將出而復止；

translations.literal: Thereupon everyone knew to be cautious; words about to come forth were stopped;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon everyone knew to be cautious, and words about to come forth were stopped;

sentences.zh: 至於再申諭告，方達天聰。

translations.literal: only when the edict was repeated and announced did it reach the imperial ear.
translations.idiomatic: only when the edict was repeated and announced did it reach the imperial ear.

sentences.zh: 聞初詔乃蔡確、章惇造端，其詞盡出於惇。

translations.literal: I hear the initial edict was originated by Cai Que and Zhang Dun, and its language entirely came from Zhang Dun.
translations.idiomatic: I hear the initial edict was originated by Cai Que and Zhang Dun, and its language entirely came from Zhang Dun.

sentences.zh: 今二人既去，其餘黨常懷醜正惡直之心，願深留宸慮，以折邪謀。」

translations.literal: Now the two men are gone, but the remaining faction constantly harbors hearts that malign the upright and hate the straight; I wish Your Majesty would deeply keep this in mind to thwart evil designs.
translations.idiomatic: Now the two men are gone, but the remaining faction constantly harbors hearts that malign the upright and hate the straight. I wish Your Majesty would deeply keep this in mind to thwart evil designs.

sentences.zh: 遂論呂惠卿、鄧綰：「雖罷揚州，猶蒞小郡，小郡之民奚罪焉？

translations.literal: He then discussed Lü Huiqing and Deng Wan: "Though dismissed to Yangzhou, they still hold small prefectures—what crime have the people of small prefectures committed?
translations.idiomatic: He then discussed Lü Huiqing and Deng Wan: "Though dismissed to Yangzhou, they still hold small prefectures—what crime have the people of small prefectures committed?

sentences.zh: 乞投之散地，以謝天下。」

translations.literal: I beg to cast them to idle posts to answer to all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: I beg to cast them to idle posts to answer to all under heaven."

sentences.zh: 又言：「近彈王中正、石得一等，雖已薄責，得一所任肘腋小人，如翟勍之徒，亦宜編削。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Recently impeaching Wang Zhongzheng, Shi Deyi, and others—though lightly punished, the petty men they employed at their side, such as Zhai Qing and his kind, should also be demoted and stripped."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Recently impeaching Wang Zhongzheng, Shi Deyi, and others—though lightly punished, the petty men they employed at their side, such as Zhai Qing and his kind, should also be demoted and stripped."

sentences.zh: 詔並降支郡營校。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all demoted to branch prefectures as camp officers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all of them demoted to branch prefectures as camp officers.

sentences.zh: 又論崔台符、賈種民舞文深酷之罪，皆逐之。

translations.literal: He also discussed Cui Taifu and Jia Zhongmin for the crime of manipulating documents with deep cruelty; all were expelled.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed Cui Taifu and Jia Zhongmin for the crime of manipulating documents with deep cruelty. All were expelled.

sentences.zh: 出為淮南轉運副使，歷右司郎中、秘書少監、太僕卿，終河東轉運使。

translations.literal: He went out as Huainan transport vice-commissioner, successively served as director in the Right Office, vice-director of the Secretariat, and Minister of the Stud, and ended as Hedong transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as Huainan transport vice-commissioner, successively served as director in the Right Office, vice-director of the Secretariat, and Minister of the Stud, and ended his career as Hedong transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 子膚，坐元符上書，陷於黨籍。

translations.literal: His son Fu, because of submitting a memorial in the Yuanfu era, was implicated in the faction register.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fu, because of submitting a memorial in the Yuanfu era, was implicated in the faction register.

sentences.zh: 蔣之奇

translations.literal: Jiang Zhiqi
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhiqi

sentences.zh: 蔣之奇，字穎叔，常州宜興人。

translations.literal: Jiang Zhiqi, styled Yingshu, a native of Yixing in Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhiqi, styled Yingshu, was a native of Yixing in Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 以伯父樞密直學士堂蔭得官。

translations.literal: Through his uncle's privilege as direct academician at the Bureau of Military Affairs he obtained office.
translations.idiomatic: Through his uncle's privilege as direct academician at the Bureau of Military Affairs he obtained office.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第，中《春秋》三傳科，至太常博士；

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, placed in the Three Commentaries on the Spring and Autumn Annals category, and rose to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination, placed in the Three Commentaries on the Spring and Autumn Annals category, and rose to doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;

sentences.zh: 又舉賢良方正，試六論中選，及對策，失書問目，報罷。

translations.literal: He was also recommended as worthy and upright; in the six-essay examination he was selected, but in the policy response he failed to write the question topics and was reported dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was also recommended as worthy and upright. In the six-essay examination he was selected, but in the policy response he failed to write the question topics and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 英宗覽而善之，擢監察御史。

translations.literal: Yingzong read it and approved, and promoted him to censor.
translations.idiomatic: Yingzong read it and approved, and promoted him to censor.

sentences.zh: 神宗立，轉殿中侍御史，上謹始五事：一曰進忠賢，二曰退奸邪，三曰納諫諍，四曰遠近習，五曰閉女謁。

translations.literal: When Shenzong ascended, he was transferred to palace censor and submitted five matters of careful beginning: first, advance the loyal and worthy; second, remove the treacherous and evil; third, accept remonstrance; fourth, keep distant close associates; fifth, close off women's petitions.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong ascended the throne, he was transferred to palace censor and submitted five matters of careful beginning: first, advance the loyal and worthy; second, remove the treacherous and evil; third, accept remonstrance; fourth, keep distant close associates; fifth, close off women's petitions.

sentences.zh: 神宗顧之曰：「斜封、墨敕必無有，至於近習之戒，孟子所謂『觀遠臣以其所主』者也。」

translations.literal: Shenzong looked at him and said: "Slanting seals and ink edicts surely will not exist; as for the warning about close associates, this is what Mencius called 'observe distant ministers by those they serve.'"
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong looked at him and said, "Slanting seals and ink edicts surely will not exist. As for the warning about close associates, this is what Mencius called 'observe distant ministers by those they serve.'"

sentences.zh: 之奇對曰：「陛下之言及此，天下何憂不治。」

translations.literal: Zhiqi replied: "Your Majesty's words reaching this point—what worry is there that all under heaven will not be well governed?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi replied, "Your Majesty's words reaching this point—what worry is there that all under heaven will not be well governed?"

sentences.zh: 初，之奇為歐陽修所厚，制科既黜，乃詣修盛言濮議之善，以得御史。

translations.literal: Initially Zhiqi was favored by Ouyang Xiu; after failing the special examination, he went to Xiu and spoke at length of the excellence of the Pu discussion, thereby obtaining the censor post.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Zhiqi was favored by Ouyang Xiu. After failing the special examination, he went to Xiu and spoke at length of the excellence of the Pu discussion, thereby obtaining the censor post.

sentences.zh: 復懼不為眾所容，因修妻弟薛良孺得罪怨修，誣修及婦吳氏事，遂劾修。

translations.literal: Again fearing he would not be accepted by the multitude, because Xiu's wife's younger brother Xue Liangru had offended and resented Xiu, he falsely accused Xiu and his wife Lady Wu, and impeached Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: Again fearing he would not be accepted by the multitude, and because Xiu's wife's younger brother Xue Liangru had offended and resented Xiu, he falsely accused Xiu and his wife Lady Wu, and impeached Xiu.

sentences.zh: 神宗批付中書，問狀無實，貶監道州酒稅，仍榜朝堂。

translations.literal: Shenzong annotated and sent it to the Secretariat; inquiry found no substance; he was demoted to supervise wine tax at Daozhou, and the notice was posted at court.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong annotated and sent it to the Secretariat. Inquiry found no substance. He was demoted to supervise wine tax at Daozhou, and the notice was posted at court.

sentences.zh: 至州，上表哀謝，神宗憐其有母，改監宣州稅。

translations.literal: Arriving at the prefecture, he submitted a memorial of sorrowful apology; Shenzong pitied him for having a mother and changed him to supervise tax at Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Arriving at the prefecture, he submitted a memorial of sorrowful apology. Shenzong pitied him for having a mother and changed him to supervise tax at Xuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 新法行，為福建轉運判官。

translations.literal: When the new laws were implemented, he became Fujian transport vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the new laws were implemented, he became Fujian transport vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時諸道免役推行失平，之奇約僦庸費，隨算錢高下均取之，民以為便。

translations.literal: At the time the exemption-from-corvée policy was implemented unevenly in various circuits; Zhiqi fixed hired-labor costs and collected uniformly according to the amount of calculated money; the people found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the exemption-from-corvée policy was implemented unevenly in various circuits. Zhiqi fixed hired-labor costs and collected uniformly according to the amount of calculated money. The people found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 遷淮東轉運副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Huaidong transport vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Huaidong transport vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 歲惡民流，之奇募使修水利以食流者。

translations.literal: In a bad year people fled; Zhiqi recruited laborers to repair waterworks to feed the displaced.
translations.idiomatic: In a bad year people fled. Zhiqi recruited laborers to repair waterworks to feed the displaced.

sentences.zh: 如揚之天長三十六陂，宿之臨渙橫斜三溝，尤其大也，用工至百萬，溉田九千頃，活民八萬四千。

translations.literal: Such as the thirty-six embankments of Tianchang in Yang, and the three diagonal canals of Linhuan in Su—these were especially large; labor used reached a million, irrigating nine thousand qing of fields, sustaining eighty-four thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: Such as the thirty-six embankments of Tianchang in Yangzhou, and the three diagonal canals of Linhuan in Suzhou—these were especially large. Labor used reached a million, irrigating nine thousand qing of fields and sustaining eighty-four thousand people.

sentences.zh: 歷江西、河北、陝西副使。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice-commissioner in Jiangxi, Hebei, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as vice-commissioner in Jiangxi, Hebei, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 之奇在陝西，經賦入以給用度，公私用足。

translations.literal: Zhiqi in Shaanxi managed tax revenues to supply expenses; public and private use was sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi in Shaanxi managed tax revenues to supply expenses, and public and private needs were met.

sentences.zh: 比其去，庫緡八十餘萬，邊粟皆支二年。

translations.literal: By the time he left, the treasury held over eight hundred thousand strings of cash, and frontier grain could supply two years.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he left, the treasury held over eight hundred thousand strings of cash, and frontier grain could supply two years.

sentences.zh: 移淮南，擢江、淮、荊、浙發運副使。

translations.literal: Transferred to Huainan, he was promoted to vice-commissioner of grain transport for Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Huainan, he was promoted to vice-commissioner of grain transport for Jiang, Huai, Jing, and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，漕粟至京，比常歲溢六百二十萬石，錫服三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, grain transported to the capital exceeded the normal year by six million two hundred thousand shi; he was granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Yuanfeng era, grain transported to the capital exceeded the normal year by six million two hundred thousand shi. He was granted third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 請鑿龜山左肘至洪澤為新河，以避淮險，自是無覆溺之患。

translations.literal: He requested to cut from the left elbow of Guishan to Hongze as a new river to avoid Huai River dangers; from then on there was no calamity of capsizing and drowning.
translations.idiomatic: He requested to cut a new river from the left elbow of Guishan to Hongze to avoid Huai River dangers. From then on there was no calamity of capsizing and drowning.

sentences.zh: 詔增二秩，加直龍圖閣，升發運使。

translations.literal: An edict increased his rank by two steps, added direct appointment at the Dragon Diagram Hall, and promoted him to transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict increased his rank by two steps, added direct appointment at the Dragon Diagram Hall, and promoted him to transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 凡六年，其所經度， 皆為一司故事。

translations.literal: In all six years, what he planned and measured all became precedents for the office.
translations.idiomatic: In all six years, what he planned and measured all became precedents for the office.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，進天章閣待制、知潭州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou he was promoted to academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns and made magistrate of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era, he was promoted to academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns and appointed magistrate of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 御史韓川、孫升、諫官朱光庭皆言之奇小人，不足當斯選。

translations.literal: Censors Han Chuan and Sun Sheng and remonstrator Zhu Guangting all said Zhiqi was a petty man, unworthy of this selection.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Han Chuan and Sun Sheng and remonstrator Zhu Guangting all said Zhiqi was a petty man, unworthy of this selection.

sentences.zh: 改集賢殿修撰、知廣州。

translations.literal: He was changed to compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and magistrate of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and magistrate of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 妖人岑探善幻，聚黨二千人，謀取新興，略番禺，包據嶺表，群不逞借之為虐，其勢張甚。

translations.literal: The sorcerer Cen Tan was skilled in illusion; he gathered a band of two thousand men, plotted to seize Xinxing, plunder Panyu, and envelop Lingnan; the unruly borrowed his power to do harm, and his momentum was greatly swelling.
translations.idiomatic: The sorcerer Cen Tan was skilled in illusion. He gathered a band of two thousand men, plotted to seize Xinxing, plunder Panyu, and envelop Lingnan. The unruly borrowed his power to do harm, and his momentum swelled greatly.

sentences.zh: 之奇遣鈐轄楊從先致討，生擒之。

translations.literal: Zhiqi sent commander Yang Congxian to attack and captured him alive.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi sent commander Yang Congxian to attack and captured him alive.

sentences.zh: 加寶文閣待制。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title of academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Precious Culture.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional title of academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Precious Culture.

sentences.zh: 南海饒寶貨，為吏者多貪聲，之奇取前世牧守有清節者吳隱之、宋璟、盧奐、李勉等，繪其象，建十賢堂以祀，冀變其習。

translations.literal: The Southern Sea abounds in precious goods; many officials who serve there have reputations for greed. Zhiqi took former prefects and governors of integrity—Wu Yinzhi, Song Jing, Lu Huan, Li Mian, and others—painted their images, and built the Hall of Ten Worthies to worship them, hoping to change the custom.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Sea abounds in precious goods, and many officials who serve there have reputations for greed. Zhiqi took former prefects and governors of integrity—Wu Yinzhi, Song Jing, Lu Huan, Li Mian, and others—painted their images, and built the Hall of Ten Worthies to worship them, hoping to change the custom.

sentences.zh: 徙河北都轉運使、知瀛州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to chief transport commissioner of Hebei and magistrate of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to chief transport commissioner of Hebei and magistrate of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 遼使耶律迪道死，所過郡守皆再拜致祭。

translations.literal: The Liao envoy Yelü Didao died; prefects and governors along the route all bowed twice and performed sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao envoy Yelü Didao died. Prefects and governors along the route all bowed twice and performed sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 之奇曰：「天子方伯，奈何為之屈膝邪！」

translations.literal: Zhiqi said: "A Son of Heaven's regional lord—how can one bend the knee for him!
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi said, "A Son of Heaven's regional lord—how can one bend the knee for him!

sentences.zh: 奠而不拜。

translations.literal: He offered libation but did not bow.
translations.idiomatic: He offered libation but did not bow.

sentences.zh: 入為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He entered [the capital] as Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復出知熙州。

translations.literal: Before long he again went out as magistrate of Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again went out as magistrate of Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏人論和，請畫封境。

translations.literal: The Tangut people discussed peace and requested demarcation of the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut people discussed peace and requested demarcation of the border.

sentences.zh: 之奇揣其非誠心，務修守備，謹斥候，常若敵至。

translations.literal: Zhiqi surmised they were not sincere and devoted himself to repairing defenses, carefully posting scouts, always as if the enemy were arriving.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi surmised they were not sincere and devoted himself to repairing defenses, carefully posting scouts, always as if the enemy were arriving.

sentences.zh: 終之奇去，夏人不敢犯塞。

translations.literal: Until Zhiqi left, the Tangut people did not dare violate the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Until Zhiqi left, the Tangut people did not dare violate the frontier.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，召為中書舍人，改知開封府，進龍圖閣直學士，拜翰林學士兼侍讀。

translations.literal: During Shaosheng he was summoned as drafter of the Secretariat, changed to magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, promoted to direct academician at the Dragon Diagram Hall, and appointed Hanlin academician and lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaosheng era he was summoned as drafter of the Secretariat, changed to magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, promoted to direct academician at the Dragon Diagram Hall, and appointed Hanlin academician and lecturer.

sentences.zh: 元符末，鄒浩以言事得罪，之奇折簡別之，責守汝州。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanfu, Zou Hao offended by speaking on affairs; Zhiqi sent a letter to bid him farewell and was punished to guard Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Yuanfu era, Zou Hao offended by speaking on affairs. Zhiqi sent a letter to bid him farewell and was punished by being assigned to guard Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 閱月，徙慶州。

translations.literal: After a month he was transferred to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After a month he was transferred to Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 之奇為部使者十二任，六典會府，以治辦稱。

translations.literal: Zhiqi served twelve terms as circuit commissioner, six times administering metropolitan prefectures, and was known for efficient governance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiqi served twelve terms as circuit commissioner, six times administering metropolitan prefectures, and was known for efficient governance.

sentences.zh: 且孜孜以人物為己任，在閩薦處士陳烈，在淮南薦孝子徐積，每行部至，必造之。

translations.literal: Moreover he diligently took recommending persons as his responsibility; in Min he recommended the recluse Chen Lie, in Huainan the filial son Xu Ji; whenever he toured his circuit he always visited them.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover he diligently took recommending persons as his responsibility. In Min he recommended the recluse Chen Lie; in Huainan he recommended the filial son Xu Ji. Whenever he toured his circuit he always visited them.

sentences.zh: 特以畔歐陽修之故，為清議所薄。

translations.literal: Only because he turned against Ouyang Xiu was he scorned by pure opinion.
translations.idiomatic: Only because he had turned against Ouyang Xiu was he scorned by pure opinion.

sentences.zh: 子：皆，至侍從。

translations.literal: His son Jie rose to attendant.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jie rose to attendant.

sentences.zh: 曾孫：芾，別有傳。

translations.literal: Great-grandson Fei has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Fei has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 陸佃，字農師，越州山陰人。

translations.literal: Lu Tian, styled Nongshi, a native of Shanyin in Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tian, styled Nongshi, was a native of Shanyin in Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 居貧苦學，夜無燈，映月光讀書。

translations.literal: Living in poverty he studied hard; at night with no lamp he read by moonlight.
translations.idiomatic: Living in poverty he studied hard. At night with no lamp he read by moonlight.

sentences.zh: 躡屩從師，不遠千里。

translations.literal: Wearing straw sandals he followed teachers, not fearing a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Wearing straw sandals he followed teachers, not fearing journeys of a thousand li.

sentences.zh: 過金陵，受經於王安石。

translations.literal: Passing Jinling, he received the classics from Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: Passing through Jinling, he received instruction in the classics from Wang Anshi.

sentences.zh: 熙寧三年，應舉入京。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xining he entered the capital for the examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Xining era he entered the capital for the examination.

sentences.zh: 適安石當國，首問新政，佃曰：「法非不善，但推行不能如初意，還為擾民，如青苗是也。」

translations.literal: Just as Wang Anshi was in power, he first asked about the new policies; Tian said: "The laws are not ungood, but implementation cannot match the original intent and instead disturbs the people, as with the Green Sprouts policy."
translations.idiomatic: Just as Wang Anshi was in power, he first asked about the new policies. Tian said, "The laws are not ungood, but implementation cannot match the original intent and instead disturbs the people, as with the Green Sprouts policy."

sentences.zh: 安石驚曰：「何為乃爾？

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said in alarm: "Why is it like this?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said in alarm, "Why is it like this?

sentences.zh: 吾與呂惠卿議之，又訪外議。」

translations.literal: I discussed it with Lü Huiqing and also sought outside opinion."
translations.idiomatic: I discussed it with Lü Huiqing and also sought outside opinion."

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「公樂聞善，古所未有，然外間頗以為拒諫。」

translations.literal: Tian said: "Your Lordship delights in hearing what is good—unprecedented since antiquity—yet outside opinion rather takes it as rejecting remonstrance."
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "Your Lordship delights in hearing what is good—unprecedented since antiquity—yet outside opinion rather takes it as rejecting remonstrance."

sentences.zh: 安石笑曰：「吾豈拒諫者？

translations.literal: Wang Anshi smiled and said: "How could I be one who rejects remonstrance?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi smiled and said, "How could I be one who rejects remonstrance?

sentences.zh: 但邪說營營，顧無足聽。」

translations.literal: Only heretical talk buzzes about—hardly worth listening to."
translations.idiomatic: Only heretical talk buzzes about—hardly worth listening to."

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「是乃所以致人言也。」

translations.literal: Tian said: "That is precisely what causes people to speak."
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "That is precisely what causes people to speak."

sentences.zh: 明日，安石召謂之曰：「惠卿云：『私家取債，亦須一雞半豚。』

translations.literal: The next day Wang Anshi summoned him and said: "Huiqing says: 'Even private lending requires a chicken or half a pig.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Wang Anshi summoned him and said, "Huiqing says, 'Even private lending requires a chicken or half a pig.

sentences.zh: 已遣李承之使淮南質究矣。」

translations.literal: I have already sent Li Chengzhi to Huainan to investigate on the spot."
translations.idiomatic: I have already sent Li Chengzhi to Huainan to investigate on the spot.'"

sentences.zh: 既而承之還，詭言於民無不便，佃說不行。

translations.literal: Before long Chengzhi returned and falsely reported that the people had no inconvenience; Tian's argument was not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Chengzhi returned and falsely reported that the people had no inconvenience. Tian's argument was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 禮部奏名為舉首。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites submitted his name as first in the examination.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites submitted his name as first in the examination.

sentences.zh: 方廷試賦，遽發策題，士皆愕然；

translations.literal: Just as the palace examination fu was underway, the policy question was suddenly issued; scholars were all startled;
translations.idiomatic: Just as the palace examination fu was underway, the policy question was suddenly issued. Scholars were all startled;

sentences.zh: 佃從容條對，擢甲科。

translations.literal: Tian calmly answered item by item and was placed in the top grade.
translations.idiomatic: Tian calmly answered item by item and was placed in the top grade.

sentences.zh: 授蔡州推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed judicial assistant at Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed judicial assistant at Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 初置五路學，選為鄆州教授，召補國子監直講。

translations.literal: When the five-circuit schools were first established, he was selected as professor at Yanzhou and summoned to fill the post of lecturer at the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: When the five-circuit schools were first established, he was selected as professor at Yanzhou and summoned to fill the post of lecturer at the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 安石以佃不附己，專付之經術，不復諮以政。

translations.literal: Because Tian did not attach himself to Wang Anshi, he was entrusted solely with classical learning and no longer consulted on government.
translations.idiomatic: Because Tian did not attach himself to Wang Anshi, he was entrusted solely with classical learning and no longer consulted on government.

sentences.zh: 安石子雱用事，好進者坌集其門，至崇以師禮，佃待之如常。

translations.literal: When Wang Anshi's son Bian held power, those eager to advance thronged his gate, even honoring him with the rites due a teacher; Tian treated him as usual.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Anshi's son Bian held power, those eager to advance thronged his gate, even honoring him with the rites due a teacher. Tian treated him as usual.

sentences.zh: 同王子韶修定《說文》。

translations.literal: Together with Wang Zishao he revised and fixed the Shuowen.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Wang Zishao he revised and fixed the Shuowen.

sentences.zh: 入見，神宗問大裘襲袞，佃考禮以對。

translations.literal: Entering audience, Shenzong asked about the great fur robe and the layered ceremonial robe; Tian examined the rites and replied.
translations.idiomatic: Entering audience, Shenzong asked about the great fur robe and the layered ceremonial robe. Tian examined the rites and replied.

sentences.zh: 神宗悅，用為祥定郊廟禮文官。

translations.literal: Shenzong was pleased and employed him as an officer for determining suburban and temple ritual texts.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong was pleased and employed him as an officer for determining suburban and temple ritual texts.

sentences.zh: 時同列皆侍從，佃獨以光祿丞居其間。

translations.literal: At the time his colleagues were all attendants; Tian alone held the rank of assistant director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments among them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his colleagues were all attendants. Tian alone held the rank of assistant director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments among them.

sentences.zh: 每有所議，神宗輒曰：「自王、鄭以來，言禮未有如佃者。」

translations.literal: Whenever there was discussion, Shenzong would say: "Since Wang and Zheng, none who speak of rites have been like Tian."
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there was discussion, Shenzong would say, "Since Wang and Zheng, none who speak of rites have been like Tian."

sentences.zh: 加集賢校理、崇政殿說書，進講《周官》，神宗稱善，始命先一夕進稿。

translations.literal: He was given the additional posts of collator at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and lecturer at the Hall of Promoting Governance; he lectured on the Offices of Zhou; Shenzong praised it and first ordered drafts submitted the night before.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the additional posts of collator at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and lecturer at the Hall of Promoting Governance. He lectured on the Offices of Zhou. Shenzong praised it and first ordered drafts submitted the night before.

sentences.zh: 同修起居注。

translations.literal: He jointly compiled the Daily Records.
translations.idiomatic: He jointly compiled the Daily Records.

sentences.zh: 元豐定官制，擢中書舍人、給事中。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng office system was fixed, he was promoted to drafter of the Secretariat and attendant censor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuanfeng office system was fixed, he was promoted to drafter of the Secretariat and attendant censor.

sentences.zh: 哲宗立，太常請復太廟牙盤食。

translations.literal: When Zhezong ascended, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested restoring tooth-tray offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhezong ascended the throne, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices requested restoring tooth-tray offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 博士呂希純、少卿趙令鑠皆以為當復。

translations.literal: Doctors Lü Xichun and vice-director Zhao Lingshuo all held that it should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Doctors Lü Xichun and vice-director Zhao Lingshuo all held that it should be restored.

sentences.zh: 佃言：「太廟，用先王之禮，於用俎豆為稱；

translations.literal: Tian said: "The Imperial Ancestral Temple uses the rites of former kings; using stands and vessels is appropriate;
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "The Imperial Ancestral Temple uses the rites of former kings. Using stands and vessels is appropriate;

sentences.zh: 景靈宮、原廟，用時王之禮，於用牙盤為稱，不可易也。」

translations.literal: the Jingling Palace and the original temples use the rites of the present king; using tooth-trays is appropriate—they cannot be changed."
translations.idiomatic: the Jingling Palace and the original temples use the rites of the present king. Using tooth-trays is appropriate—they cannot be changed."

sentences.zh: 卒從佃議。

translations.literal: In the end they followed Tian's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: In the end they followed Tian's proposal.

sentences.zh: 是時，更先朝法度，去安石之黨，士多諱變所從。

translations.literal: At this time the previous reign's laws and institutions were changed and Wang Anshi's faction was removed; scholars mostly concealed changes in whom they followed.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the previous reign's laws and institutions were changed and Wang Anshi's faction was removed. Scholars mostly concealed changes in whom they followed.

sentences.zh: 安石卒，佃率諸生供佛，哭而祭之，識者嘉其無向背。

translations.literal: When Wang Anshi died, Tian led the students to offer to Buddha, wept, and sacrificed to him; the discerning praised him for having no shifting allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Anshi died, Tian led the students to offer to Buddha, wept, and sacrificed to him. The discerning praised him for having no shifting allegiance.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部侍郎，以修撰《神宗實錄》徙禮部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel; because of compiling the Veritable Records of Shenzong he was moved to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel. Because of compiling the Veritable Records of Shenzong he was moved to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 數與史官范祖禹、黃庭堅爭辨，大要多是安石，為之晦隱。

translations.literal: He repeatedly argued with historians Fan Zuyu and Huang Tingjian; mostly he sided with Wang Anshi and concealed matters for him.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly argued with historians Fan Zuyu and Huang Tingjian. Mostly he sided with Wang Anshi and concealed matters for him.

sentences.zh: 庭堅曰：「如公言，蓋佞史也。」

translations.literal: Tingjian said: "By your words, you are a flatterer-historian."
translations.idiomatic: Tingjian said, "By your words, you are a flatterer-historian."

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「盡用君意，豈非謗書乎！」

translations.literal: Tian said: "If we fully used your intent, would it not be a book of slander!"
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "If we fully used your intent, would it not be a book of slander!"

sentences.zh: 進權禮部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to acting Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to acting Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 鄭雍論其穿鑿附會，改龍圖閣待制、知潁州。

translations.literal: Zheng Yong argued that he forced connections and strained interpretations; he was changed to academician awaiting orders at the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yong argued that he forced connections and strained interpretations. He was changed to academician awaiting orders at the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 佃以歐陽修守潁有遺愛，為建祠宇。

translations.literal: Because Ouyang Xiu when governing Ying had left beloved memory, Tian built a shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ouyang Xiu when governing Ying had left beloved memory, Tian built a shrine for him.

sentences.zh: 《實錄》成，加直學士，又為韓川、朱光庭所議，詔止增秩，徙知鄧州。

translations.literal: When the Veritable Records were completed, he was given direct academician rank; again criticized by Han Chuan and Zhu Guangting, an edict only increased his rank and transferred him to be magistrate of Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Veritable Records were completed, he was given direct academician rank. Again criticized by Han Chuan and Zhu Guangting, an edict only increased his rank and transferred him to be magistrate of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，知江寧府。

translations.literal: Before long he was made magistrate of Jiangning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made magistrate of Jiangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甫至，祭安石墓。

translations.literal: As soon as he arrived, he sacrificed at Wang Anshi's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as he arrived, he sacrificed at Wang Anshi's tomb.

sentences.zh: 句容人盜嫂害其兄，別誣三人同謀。

translations.literal: A man of Jurong stole his sister-in-law and killed his elder brother, then separately falsely accused three men of conspiring together.
translations.idiomatic: A man of Jurong stole his sister-in-law and killed his elder brother, then separately falsely accused three men of conspiring together.

sentences.zh: 既皆訊服，一囚父以冤訴，通判以下皆曰：「彼怖死耳，獄已成，不可變。」

translations.literal: After all had confessed under interrogation, one prisoner's father appealed on grounds of injustice; the vice-prefect and below all said: "He is merely terrified of death; the case is already settled and cannot be changed."
translations.idiomatic: After all had confessed under interrogation, one prisoner's father appealed on grounds of injustice. The vice-prefect and below all said, "He is merely terrified of death. The case is already settled and cannot be changed."

sentences.zh: 佃為閱實，三人皆得生。

translations.literal: Tian reviewed the facts, and all three men were spared.
translations.idiomatic: Tian reviewed the facts, and all three men were spared.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，治《實錄》罪，坐落職，知秦州，改海州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng, prosecuted for the Veritable Records affair, he was demoted and stripped of office, made magistrate of Qinzhou, then changed to Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shaosheng era, prosecuted for the Veritable Records affair, he was demoted and stripped of office, made magistrate of Qinzhou, then changed to Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 朝論灼其情，復集賢殿修撰，移知蔡。

translations.literal: Court discussion clarified the circumstances; he was restored as compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and transferred to be magistrate of Cai.
translations.idiomatic: Court discussion clarified the circumstances. He was restored as compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and transferred to be magistrate of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 徽宗即位，召為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Huizong ascended, he was summoned as Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Huizong ascended the throne, he was summoned as Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 上疏曰：「人君踐祚，要在正始，正始之道，本於朝廷。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: "When a ruler ascends the throne, the key lies in a correct beginning; the way of a correct beginning is rooted in the court.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial saying, "When a ruler ascends the throne, the key lies in a correct beginning. The way of a correct beginning is rooted in the court.

sentences.zh: 近時學士大夫相傾競進，以善求事為精神，以能訐人為風采，以忠厚為重遲，以靜退為卑弱。

translations.literal: Recently scholars and officials undermined each other in competing advancement; taking skill in seeking affairs as spirit, ability to expose others as style, loyalty and honesty as sluggishness, and quiet withdrawal as weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Recently scholars and officials undermined each other in competing for advancement. They took skill in seeking affairs as spirit, ability to expose others as style, loyalty and honesty as sluggishness, and quiet withdrawal as weakness.

sentences.zh: 相師成風，莫之或止，正而救之，實在今日。

translations.literal: Teaching each other, it became custom; none could stop it; to correct and rescue it is truly a task for today.
translations.idiomatic: Teaching each other, it became custom. None could stop it. To correct and rescue it is truly a task for today.

sentences.zh: 神宗延登真儒，立法制治，而元祐之際，悉肆紛更。

translations.literal: Shenzong extended invitation to true scholars, established laws and governed, yet during Yuanyou all were wildly changed.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong extended invitation to true scholars, established laws and governed, yet during the Yuanyou era all were wildly changed.

sentences.zh: 紹聖以來，又皆稱頌。

translations.literal: Since Shaosheng, all have again been praised.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Shaosheng era, all have again been praised.

sentences.zh: 夫善續前人者，不必因所為，否者賡之，善者揚焉。

translations.literal: One who well continues predecessors need not follow what they did; what was wrong should be continued against, what was good should be raised up.
translations.idiomatic: One who well continues predecessors need not follow what they did. What was wrong should be continued against; what was good should be raised up.

sentences.zh: 元祐紛更，是知賡之而不知揚之之罪也；

translations.literal: Yuanyou's wild changes were the fault of knowing how to continue against but not knowing how to raise up;
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanyou era's wild changes were the fault of knowing how to continue against but not knowing how to raise up;

sentences.zh: 紹聖稱頌，是知揚之而不知賡之之過也。

translations.literal: Shaosheng's praise was the error of knowing how to raise up but not knowing how to continue against.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaosheng era's praise was the error of knowing how to raise up but not knowing how to continue against.

sentences.zh: 願諮謀人賢，詢考政事，惟其當之為貴，大中之期，亦在今日也。」

translations.literal: I wish to consult and plan with worthy men, inquire and examine governance—only what is fitting is precious; the expectation of great centrality is also in today.
translations.idiomatic: I wish to consult and plan with worthy men and inquire and examine governance. Only what is fitting is precious. The expectation of great centrality is also in today.

sentences.zh: 徽宗遂命修《哲宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Huizong then ordered compilation of the Veritable Records of Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong then ordered compilation of the Veritable Records of Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部尚書，報聘於遼，歸，半道聞遼主洪基喪，送伴者赴臨而返，誚佃曰：「國哀如是，漢使殊無吊唁之儀，何也？」

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel and returned an envoy mission to Liao; on the way back, halfway he heard the Liao ruler Hongji had died; the escort went to mourn and returned, mocking Tian: "The state's mourning is such—yet the Song envoy has no condolence rites. Why?
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel and returned an envoy mission to Liao. On the way back, halfway he heard the Liao ruler Hongji had died. The escort went to mourn and returned, mocking Tian: "The state's mourning is such—yet the Song envoy has no condolence rites. Why?

sentences.zh: 佃徐應曰：「始意君匍匐哭踴而相見，即行吊禮；

translations.literal: Tian slowly replied: "At first I thought you would crawl and weep and wail when we met, and then I would perform condolence rites;
translations.idiomatic: Tian slowly replied, "At first I thought you would crawl and weep and wail when we met, and then I would perform condolence rites;

sentences.zh: 今偃然如常時，尚何所吊？」

translations.literal: now you are at ease as in normal times—what is there to condole?"
translations.idiomatic: now you are at ease as in normal times—what is there to condole?"

sentences.zh: 伴者不能答。

translations.literal: The escort could not reply.
translations.idiomatic: The escort could not reply.

sentences.zh: 拜尚書右丞。

translations.literal: He was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 將祀南郊，有司欲飾大裘匣，度用黃金多，佃請易以銀。

translations.literal: When about to sacrifice at the southern suburb, the officials wished to decorate the great fur robe case; estimating much gold would be used, Tian requested replacing it with silver.
translations.idiomatic: When about to sacrifice at the southern suburb, the officials wished to decorate the great fur robe case. Estimating that much gold would be used, Tian requested replacing it with silver.

sentences.zh: 徽宗曰：「匣必用飾邪？」

translations.literal: Huizong said: "Must the case use decoration?"
translations.idiomatic: Huizong said, "Must the case use decoration?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「大裘尚質，後世加飾焉，非禮也。」

translations.literal: He replied: "The great fur robe values simplicity; later ages added decoration—this is not rite."
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "The great fur robe values simplicity. Later ages added decoration—this is not rite."

sentences.zh: 徽宗曰：「然則罷之可乎？

translations.literal: Huizong said: "Then may we abolish it?
translations.idiomatic: Huizong said, "Then may we abolish it?

sentences.zh: 數日來，豐稷屢言之矣。」

translations.literal: These past days Feng Ji has repeatedly spoken of it."
translations.idiomatic: These past days Feng Ji has repeatedly spoken of it."

sentences.zh: 佃因贊曰：「陛下及此，盛德之舉也。」

translations.literal: Tian thereupon praised: "Your Majesty reaching this point is an act of great virtue."
translations.idiomatic: Tian thereupon praised, "Your Majesty reaching this point is an act of great virtue."

sentences.zh: 徽宗欲親祀北郊，大臣以為盛暑不可，徽宗意甚確。

translations.literal: Huizong wished to personally sacrifice at the northern suburb; great ministers thought the great heat made it impossible; Huizong's intent was very firm.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong wished to personally sacrifice at the northern suburb. Great ministers thought the great heat made it impossible, but Huizong's intent was very firm.

sentences.zh: 朝退，皆曰：「上不以為勞，當遂行之。」

translations.literal: After court dismissal, all said: "The emperor does not consider it laborious—we should proceed."
translations.idiomatic: After court dismissal, all said, "The emperor does not consider it laborious—we should proceed."

sentences.zh: 李清臣不以為然。

translations.literal: Li Qingchen did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qingchen did not agree.

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「元豐非合祭而是北郊，公之議也。

translations.literal: Tian said: "In Yuanfeng it was not combined sacrifice but the northern suburb—this was your proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "In the Yuanfeng era it was not combined sacrifice but the northern suburb—this was your proposal.

sentences.zh: 今反以為不可，何耶？」

translations.literal: Now you instead say it is impossible—why?"
translations.idiomatic: Now you instead say it is impossible—why?"

sentences.zh: 清臣乃止。

translations.literal: Qingchen then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Qingchen then stopped.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞趙挺之以論事不當，罰金。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Zhao Tingzhi was fined for improper discussion of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Zhao Tingzhi was fined for improper discussion of affairs.

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「中丞不可罰，罰則不可為中丞。」

translations.literal: Tian said: "The censor-in-chief cannot be fined; if fined, one cannot serve as censor-in-chief."
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "The censor-in-chief cannot be fined. If fined, one cannot serve as censor-in-chief."

sentences.zh: 諫官陳瓘上書，曾布怒其尊私史而壓宗廟。

translations.literal: Remonstrator Chen Guan submitted a memorial; Zeng Bu was angry that he honored private histories and suppressed the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrator Chen Guan submitted a memorial. Zeng Bu was angry that he honored private histories and suppressed the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 佃曰：「瓘上書雖無取，不必深怒，若不能容，是成其名也。」

translations.literal: Tian said: "Though Guan's memorial has nothing to recommend it, there is no need for deep anger; if you cannot tolerate it, you make his name."
translations.idiomatic: Tian said, "Though Guan's memorial has nothing to recommend it, there is no need for deep anger. If you cannot tolerate it, you make his name."

sentences.zh: 佃執政與曾布比，而持論多近恕。

translations.literal: Tian in power was allied with Zeng Bu, yet his arguments mostly leaned toward forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: Tian in power was allied with Zeng Bu, yet his arguments mostly leaned toward forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 每欲參用元祐人才，尤惡奔競，嘗曰：「天下多事，須不次用人；

translations.literal: He often wished to employ Yuanyou talent alongside others, especially hated rushing and competition, and once said: "When the empire has many affairs, one must use men out of turn;
translations.idiomatic: He often wished to employ Yuanyou talent alongside others and especially hated rushing and competition. He once said, "When the empire has many affairs, one must use men out of turn;

sentences.zh: 苟安寧時，人之才無大相遠，當以資歷序進。

translations.literal: if times are peaceful, men's talents differ little—one should advance them in order of seniority.
translations.idiomatic: if times are peaceful, men's talents differ little—one should advance them in order of seniority.

sentences.zh: 少緩之，則士知自重矣。」

translations.literal: Slow it slightly, and scholars will know to value themselves."
translations.idiomatic: Slow it slightly, and scholars will know to value themselves."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「今天下之勢，如人大病向愈，當以藥餌輔養之，須其安平；

translations.literal: He also said: "Today's situation under heaven is like a person whose great illness is turning toward recovery—one should nourish with medicine and diet, waiting for peace and stability;
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Today's situation under heaven is like a person whose great illness is turning toward recovery. One should nourish with medicine and diet, waiting for peace and stability;

sentences.zh: 苟為輕事改作，是使之騎射也。」

translations.literal: if one lightly changes and remakes affairs, it is like making him ride and shoot."
translations.idiomatic: if one lightly changes and remakes affairs, it is like making him ride and shoot."

sentences.zh: 轉左丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 御史論呂希純、劉安世復職太驟，請加鐫抑，且欲更懲元祐餘黨。

translations.literal: Censors argued that Lü Xichun and Liu Anshi were restored to office too hastily; they requested further demotion and also wished to punish remaining Yuanyou faction members.
translations.idiomatic: Censors argued that Lü Xichun and Liu Anshi were restored to office too hastily. They requested further demotion and also wished to punish remaining Yuanyou faction members.

sentences.zh: 佃為徽宗言不宜窮治，乃下詔申諭，揭之朝堂。

translations.literal: Tian told Huizong it was not appropriate to pursue to the end; an edict was issued to clarify and instruct, posted at court.
translations.idiomatic: Tian told Huizong it was not appropriate to pursue to the end. An edict was issued to clarify and instruct, posted at court.

sentences.zh: 讒者用是詆佃，曰：「佃名在黨籍，不欲窮治，正恐自及耳。」

translations.literal: Slanderers used this to attack Tian, saying: "Tian's name is on the faction register; he does not wish to pursue to the end—he truly fears reaching himself."
translations.idiomatic: Slanderers used this to attack Tian, saying, "Tian's name is on the faction register. He does not wish to pursue to the end—he truly fears reaching himself."

sentences.zh: 遂罷為中大夫、知亳州，數月卒，年六十一。

translations.literal: He was then dismissed to be grandee of the palace and magistrate of Bozhou; several months later he died, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He was then dismissed to serve as grandee of the palace and magistrate of Bozhou. Several months later he died, at the age of sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 追復資政殿學士。

translations.literal: He was posthumously restored as academician of the Hall of Asset Administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously restored as academician of the Hall of Asset Administration.

sentences.zh: 佃著書二百四十二卷，於禮家、名數之說尤精，如《埤雅》、《禮象》、《春秋後傳》皆傳於世。

translations.literal: Tian authored two hundred forty-two juan of books; he was especially expert in ritualists' and numerical nomenclature theories; works such as the Piya, Rites Imagery, and Later Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals all circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Tian authored two hundred forty-two juan of books. He was especially expert in ritualists' and numerical nomenclature theories. Works such as the Piya, Rites Imagery, and Later Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals all circulated in the world.

sentences.zh: 吳居厚

translations.literal: Wu Juhou
translations.idiomatic: Wu Juhou

sentences.zh: 吳居厚，字敦老，洪州人。

translations.literal: Wu Juhou, styled Dunlao, a native of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Juhou, styled Dunlao, was a native of Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 第嘉祐進士，熙寧初，為武安節度推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jiayou jinshi examination; at the beginning of Xining he was judicial assistant of the Wu'an military commission.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jiayou jinshi examination. At the beginning of the Xining era he was judicial assistant of the Wu'an military commission.

sentences.zh: 奉行新法，盡力核閑田，以均給梅山徭，計勞，得大理丞，轉補司農屬。

translations.literal: Implementing the new laws, he exerted himself to verify idle fields and distribute them evenly to the Meishan Yao; counting his labor, he obtained the rank of assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review and was transferred to fill a post in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Implementing the new laws, he exerted himself to verify idle fields and distribute them evenly to the Meishan Yao. Counting his labor, he obtained the rank of assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review and was transferred to fill a post in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 元豐間，提舉河北常平，增損役法五十一條，賜銀緋，為京東轉運判官，升副使。

translations.literal: During Yuanfeng he directed Hebei Ever-Normal Granaries, added and reduced fifty-one articles of the corvée law, was granted silver and crimson robes, became Jingdong transport vice-commissioner, and was promoted to vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanfeng era he directed Hebei Ever-Normal Granaries, added and reduced fifty-one articles of the corvée law, was granted silver and crimson robes, became Jingdong transport vice-commissioner, and was promoted to vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 天子方興鹽、鐵，居厚精心計，籠絡鉤稽，收羨息錢數百萬。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven was just developing salt and iron; Juhou carefully calculated, coordinated and audited, and collected surplus interest money of several million.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven was just developing salt and iron. Juhou carefully calculated, coordinated and audited, and collected surplus interest money of several million.

sentences.zh: 即萊蕪、利國二冶官自鑄錢，歲得十萬緡。

translations.literal: At the Laiwu and Liguo smelting offices he personally cast coin, obtaining one hundred thousand strings per year.
translations.idiomatic: At the Laiwu and Liguo smelting offices he personally cast coin, obtaining one hundred thousand strings per year.

sentences.zh: 詔褒揭其能。

translations.literal: An edict praised and publicized his ability.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised and publicized his ability.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制、都轉運使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns and chief transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to academician awaiting orders at the Hall of Heavenly Patterns and chief transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 前使者皆以不任職蒙譴，居厚與河北蹇周輔、李南公會境上，議鹽法，搜剔無遺。

translations.literal: Previous envoys all suffered punishment for incompetence; Juhou met at the border with Jian Zhoufu and Li Nangong of Hebei to discuss the salt law, searching and extracting without omission.
translations.idiomatic: Previous envoys all suffered punishment for incompetence. Juhou met at the border with Jian Zhoufu and Li Nangong of Hebei to discuss the salt law, searching and extracting without omission.

sentences.zh: 居厚起州縣凡流，無閥閱勳庸，徒以言利得幸，不數歲，至侍從，嗜進之士從風羨美。

translations.literal: Juhou rose from ordinary county and prefecture ranks, without noble pedigree or meritorious deeds, merely gaining favor by speaking of profit; within a few years he reached attendant rank, and those eager to advance followed the wind and envied his success.
translations.idiomatic: Juhou rose from ordinary county and prefecture ranks, without noble pedigree or meritorious deeds, merely gaining favor by speaking of profit. Within a few years he reached attendant rank, and those eager to advance followed the wind and envied his success.

sentences.zh: 又請以鹽息買絹，資河東直；

translations.literal: He also requested using salt interest to buy silk and fund Hedong direct transport;
translations.idiomatic: He also requested using salt interest to buy silk and fund Hedong direct transport;

sentences.zh: 發大鐵錢二十萬貫，佐陝西軍興；

translations.literal: issued two hundred thousand strings of large iron coin to assist Shaanxi military mobilization;
translations.idiomatic: issued two hundred thousand strings of large iron coin to assist Shaanxi military mobilization;

sentences.zh: 且募民養保馬。

translations.literal: and recruited the people to raise militia horses.
translations.idiomatic: and recruited the people to raise militia horses.

sentences.zh: 當時商功利之臣，所在成聚，居厚最為掊克。

translations.literal: At the time profit-seeking officials gathered everywhere; Juhou was the most extortionate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time profit-seeking officials gathered everywhere. Juhou was the most extortionate.

sentences.zh: 劇盜王沖因民不忍，聚眾數千，欲乘其行部至徐，篡取投諸冶。

translations.literal: The notorious bandit Wang Chong, because the people could not endure it, gathered several thousand men, intending when Juhou toured his circuit to Xuzhou to seize him and throw him into the smelter.
translations.idiomatic: The notorious bandit Wang Chong, because the people could not endure it, gathered several thousand men. He intended when Juhou toured his circuit to Xuzhou to seize him and throw him into the smelter.

sentences.zh: 居厚聞知，間道遁去。

translations.literal: Juhou heard of it and fled by a hidden path.
translations.idiomatic: Juhou heard of it and fled by a hidden path.

sentences.zh: 元祐治其罪，責成州團練副使，安置黃州。

translations.literal: During Yuanyou his crime was prosecuted; he was punished as vice-commissioner of the Chengzhou militia and settled at Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanyou era his crime was prosecuted. He was punished as vice-commissioner of the Chengzhou militia and settled at Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 章惇用事，起為江淮發運使。

translations.literal: When Zhang Dun held power, he was recalled as Jiang-Huai transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Dun held power, he was recalled as Jiang-Huai transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 疏支家河通漕，楚、海之間賴其利。

translations.literal: He dredged the Zhijia River to open grain transport; between Chu and the sea they relied on its benefit.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged the Zhijia River to open grain transport. Between Chu and the sea they relied on its benefit.

sentences.zh: 召拜戶部侍郎、尚書，以龍圖閣學士知開封府，為永泰陵橋道頓遞使。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Vice Minister and Minister of Revenue, made academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, and served as relay commissioner for the Yongtai Mausoleum bridge route.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed Vice Minister and Minister of Revenue, made academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, and served as relay commissioner for the Yongtai Mausoleum bridge route.

sentences.zh: 坐積雨留滯，罷知和州。

translations.literal: Because accumulated rain caused delay, he was dismissed to be magistrate of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because accumulated rain caused delay, he was dismissed to serve as magistrate of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，復尹開封，拜尚書右丞，進中書門下侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning he again governed Kaifeng, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chongning era he again governed Kaifeng, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and advanced to Vice Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 以老避位，為資政殿學士、東太一宮使，恩許仍服方團金球文帶。

translations.literal: Citing old age he yielded his post and was made academician of the Hall of Asset Administration and commissioner of the Eastern Palace of Grand Unity; by grace he was permitted still to wear the square-round gold-sphere patterned belt.
translations.idiomatic: Citing old age he yielded his post and was made academician of the Hall of Asset Administration and commissioner of the Eastern Palace of Grand Unity. By grace he was permitted still to wear the square-round gold-sphere patterned belt.

sentences.zh: 自是，前執政在京師者視此。

translations.literal: From then on, former chief administrators in the capital looked to this as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, former chief administrators in the capital looked to this as precedent.

sentences.zh: 出為亳州、洪州，徙太原，道都門，留使祐神觀，復還政府，遷知樞密院。

translations.literal: He went out as magistrate of Bozhou and Hongzhou, transferred to Taiyuan; passing the capital gate he was retained as commissioner of the Youshen Observatory, then returned to government and was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as magistrate of Bozhou and Hongzhou, then transferred to Taiyuan. Passing the capital gate he was retained as commissioner of the Youshen Observatory, then returned to government and was transferred to director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，以武康軍節度使知洪州，卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, as military commissioner of the Wukang Army he was made magistrate of Hongzhou; he died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhenghe era, as military commissioner of the Wukang Army he was made magistrate of Hongzhou. He died at the age of seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 贈開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 居厚在政地久，以周謹自媚，無赫顯惡，唯一時聚斂，推為稱首。

translations.literal: Juhou held power for a long time, flattering with thorough caution; he had no glaring evil, only the revenue extraction of his time—he was ranked foremost.
translations.idiomatic: Juhou held power for a long time, flattering with thorough caution. He had no glaring evil, only the revenue extraction of his time—he was ranked foremost.

sentences.zh: 溫益，字禹弼，泉州人。

translations.literal: Wen Yi, styled Yubi, a native of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yi, styled Yubi, was a native of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 第進士，歷大宗正丞、利州路湖南轉運判官、工部員外郎。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as assistant director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, transport vice-commissioner of Lizhou Circuit and Hunan, and vice-director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as assistant director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, transport vice-commissioner of Lizhou Circuit and Hunan, and vice-director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，由諸王府記室出知福州，徙潭州。

translations.literal: During Shaosheng, from secretary of the princes' establishments he went out as magistrate of Fuzhou, then transferred to Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaosheng era, from secretary of the princes' establishments he went out as magistrate of Fuzhou, then transferred to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 鄒浩南遷過潭，暮投宿村寺，益即遣州都監將數卒夜出城，逼使登舟，竟淩風絕江而去。

translations.literal: Zou Hao passed through Tan on his southward exile; at dusk he lodged at a village temple; Yi immediately sent the prefectural commander with several soldiers out of the city by night, forced him aboard a boat, and he ultimately crossed the river against the wind and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Zou Hao passed through Tan on his southward exile. At dusk he lodged at a village temple. Yi immediately sent the prefectural commander with several soldiers out of the city by night, forced him aboard a boat, and he ultimately crossed the river against the wind and departed.

sentences.zh: 他逐臣在其境內，若范純仁、劉奉世、韓川、呂希純、呂陶，率為所侵困，用事者悅之。

translations.literal: Other exiled officials within his jurisdiction, such as Fan Chunren, Liu Fengshi, Han Chuan, Lü Xichun, and Lü Tao, were all harassed and distressed by him; those in power were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Other exiled officials within his jurisdiction, such as Fan Chunren, Liu Fengshi, Han Chuan, Lü Xichun, and Lü Tao, were all harassed and distressed by him. Those in power were pleased.

sentences.zh: 未及用，而徽宗以藩邸恩，召為太常少卿，遷給事中兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Before he could be further employed, Huizong out of favor from his princely residence summoned him as vice-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and transferred him to attendant censor and lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could be further employed, Huizong out of favor from his princely residence summoned him as vice-director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and transferred him to attendant censor and lecturer.

sentences.zh: 陳瓘指言其過，謂不宜列侍從、處經帷，不報。

translations.literal: Chen Guan pointed out his faults, saying he was unfit to rank among attendants or sit at the classics curtain; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan pointed out his faults, saying he was unfit to rank among attendants or sit at the classics curtain. No response was given.

sentences.zh: 改龍圖閣待制、知開封府，猶兼侍讀。

translations.literal: He was changed to academician awaiting orders at the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, still concurrently serving as lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to academician awaiting orders at the Dragon Diagram Hall and magistrate of Kaifeng Prefecture, still concurrently serving as lecturer.

sentences.zh: 時執政倡言，帝當為哲宗服兄弟之服。

translations.literal: At the time the chief administrators advocated that the emperor should wear brotherly mourning for Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the chief administrators advocated that the emperor should wear brotherly mourning for Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 曾肇在邇英讀《史記•舜紀》，因言：「昔堯、舜同出黃帝，世數已遠，然舜為堯喪三年者，以嘗臣堯故也。」

translations.literal: Zeng Zhao read the Annals of Shun in the Records of the Grand Historian at the Eying Hall and said: "Formerly Yao and Shun both descended from the Yellow Emperor; generations were already distant, yet Shun mourned Yao for three years because he had once served Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Zhao read the Annals of Shun in the Records of the Grand Historian at the Eying Hall and said, "Formerly Yao and Shun both descended from the Yellow Emperor. Generations were already distant, yet Shun mourned Yao for three years because he had once served Yao.

sentences.zh: 益意附執政，進曰：「《史記》世次不足信，堯、舜非同出。」

translations.literal: Yi intended to side with the chief administrators and advanced: "The genealogical order in the Records of the Grand Historian is not reliable; Yao and Shun did not share the same descent."
translations.idiomatic: Yi intended to side with the chief administrators and advanced, "The genealogical order in the Records of the Grand Historian is not reliable. Yao and Shun did not share the same descent."

sentences.zh: 遷吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 益仕宦從微至著，無片善可紀，至其狡譎傅合，蓋天稟然。

translations.literal: Yi in office rose from obscurity to prominence; not a shred of good could be recorded; as for his cunning and forced compliance, it was surely innate.
translations.idiomatic: Yi in office rose from obscurity to prominence. Not a shred of good could be recorded. As for his cunning and forced compliance, it was surely innate.

sentences.zh: 及是，乃時有立異。

translations.literal: By this time he occasionally took independent stands.
translations.idiomatic: By this time he occasionally took independent stands.

sentences.zh: 京一日除監司、郡守十人，益稍不謂然。

translations.literal: One day Jing appointed ten circuit commissioners and prefectural magistrates; Yi was somewhat displeased.
translations.idiomatic: One day Jing appointed ten circuit commissioners and prefectural magistrates. Yi was somewhat displeased.

sentences.zh: 京知中書舍人鄭居中與益厚，使居中自從其所問之，居中以告。

translations.literal: Jing knew that drafter of the Secretariat Zheng Juzhong was close to Yi and had Juzhong ask him on his own initiative; Juzhong reported back.
translations.idiomatic: Jing knew that drafter of the Secretariat Zheng Juzhong was close to Yi and had Juzhong ask him on his own initiative. Juzhong reported back.

sentences.zh: 益曰：「君在西掖，每見所論事，舍人得舉職，侍郎顧不許耶？

translations.literal: Yi said: "You are in the western secretariat; whenever you see matters discussed, the drafter can perform his duty—does the vice minister not permit it?
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "You are in the western secretariat. Whenever you see matters discussed, the drafter can perform his duty—does the vice minister not permit it?

sentences.zh: 今丞相所擬錢龢而下十人，皆其姻黨耳，欲不逆其意得乎？」

translations.literal: Now the chief councilor's proposed ten men from Qian He downward are all his affinal kin—how can one not go against his intent?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the chief councilor's proposed ten men from Qian He downward are all his affinal kin—how can one not go against his intent?"

sentences.zh: 京聞而頗憚焉。

translations.literal: Jing heard and was somewhat intimidated.
translations.idiomatic: Jing heard and was somewhat intimidated.

sentences.zh: 逾年，卒，年六十六。

translations.literal: After more than a year he died, aged sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he died, at the age of sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 子：萬石，至尚書。

translations.literal: His son Wanshi rose to Minister.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wanshi rose to Minister.

sentences.zh: 論曰：王安石為政，一時士大夫之素知名者，變其所守而從之，比比皆然；

translations.literal: The commentary says: When Wang Anshi governed, renowned scholar-officials of the time changed what they upheld and followed him—this was everywhere the case;
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: When Wang Anshi governed, renowned scholar-officials of the time changed what they upheld and followed him—this was everywhere the case;

sentences.zh: 元絳所蒞，咸有異政，亦諂事之，陋矣。

translations.literal: wherever Yuan Jiang served there were outstanding achievements, yet he also flattered and served Wang Anshi—how base.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever Yuan Jiang served there were outstanding achievements, yet he also flattered and served Wang Anshi—how base.

sentences.zh: 許將嘗力止發司馬光墓，此為可稱；

translations.literal: Xu Jiang once forcefully stopped the exhumation of Sima Guang's tomb—this is praiseworthy;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jiang once forcefully stopped the exhumation of Sima Guang's tomb—this is praiseworthy;

sentences.zh: 而言者謂其仕於元祐、紹聖以至建中，左右視利，幡然改圖，初無定論。

translations.literal: yet critics say that serving from Yuanyou and Shaosheng through Jianzhong, he looked left and right for profit, suddenly changed course, and from the first had no fixed judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Yet critics say that serving from the Yuanyou and Shaosheng eras through Jianzhong, he looked left and right for profit, suddenly changed course, and from the first had no fixed judgment.

sentences.zh: 鄧潤甫初掌箋記，盛有文名，而首贊紹述之謀，又表章蔡確定策之功，雖有他長，無足觀矣。

translations.literal: Deng Runfu at first managed documents and had a great literary reputation, yet he was first to praise the succession scheme and also memorialized Cai Que's merit in settling the succession; though he had other strengths, he is not worth regarding.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Runfu at first managed documents and had a great literary reputation, yet he was first to praise the succession scheme and also memorialized Cai Que's merit in settling the succession. Though he had other strengths, he is not worth regarding.

sentences.zh: 林希草制，務醜詆正人，自知隳壞名節，擲筆而悔之，何晚也；

translations.literal: Lin Xi drafted edicts, striving to slander upright men; knowing he ruined his reputation and integrity, he threw down the brush and regretted it—how late;
translations.idiomatic: Lin Xi drafted edicts, striving to slander upright men. Knowing he ruined his reputation and integrity, he threw down the brush and regretted it—how late;

sentences.zh: 弟旦反其所為，糾劾巨奸，善惡豈相掩哉！

translations.literal: his younger brother Dan reversed what he did, impeaching great villains—can good and evil cover each other!
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Dan reversed what he did, impeaching great villains—can good and evil cover each other!

sentences.zh: 蔣之奇始慫恿濮議，晚摭飛語，擊舉主以自文，小人之魁傑者也。

translations.literal: Jiang Zhiqi at first instigated the Pu discussion; in his later years he gathered slanderous rumors and struck at his patron to justify himself—a paragon among petty men.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Zhiqi at first instigated the Pu discussion. In his later years he gathered slanderous rumors and struck at his patron to justify himself—a paragon among petty men.

sentences.zh: 吳居厚奉行新法，剝下媚上，溫益阿附二蔡，物議不容。

translations.literal: Wu Juhou implemented the new laws, stripping those below and flattering those above; Wen Yi fawned on the two Cais—public opinion would not tolerate them.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Juhou implemented the new laws, stripping those below and flattering those above. Wen Yi fawned on the two Cais—public opinion would not tolerate them.

sentences.zh: 陸佃雖受經安石，而不主新法，元祐黨人之罪，請一施薄罰而已，猶差賢於眾人焉。

translations.literal: Lu Tian though he received the classics from Wang Anshi did not uphold the new laws; regarding the crimes of Yuanyou faction members, he requested only light punishment—he was still somewhat more worthy than the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tian though he received instruction in the classics from Wang Anshi did not uphold the new laws. Regarding the crimes of Yuanyou faction members, he requested only light punishment—he was still somewhat more worthy than the multitude.
